title: Invoice Extractor Provider
description: Declarative definition of how the engine extracts and downloads invoices from a SaaS billing page. One file per provider in providers/.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editor autocomplete.

id.description: Unique lowercase kebab-case slug. Must match the filename.

name.description: Display name shown in the UI.

icon.description: Emoji used as the provider icon.

billingUrl.description: Billing page URL. May contain {{config.*}} placeholders.

readySelector.description: CSS selector that indicates the billing page has loaded.

skipDedup.description: When true, always re-download all invoices, ignoring download history.

config.description: Per-user settings stored in chrome.storage.local, keyed by field name.

iframe.description: Set when the invoice table lives inside a cross-origin iframe.

urlPattern.description: Substring matched against iframe src URLs to locate the frame.

extract.description: Optional regex applied to BOTH the configured value and the page value before comparing (e.g. pull an account id out of a pasted URL). Compared for equality when it matches both sides.

storage.description: When configPattern matches the configured value, compare it exactly with the page localStorage key (raw or JSON-encoded string). Missing or unreadable IDs block downloads; otherwise use the DOM selector.

preNavigation.description: Setup performed on a different page before navigating to billingUrl.

url.description: Preparatory page URL. May contain {{config.*}} placeholders.

readySelector.description: Wait for this element before running steps.

auth.description: Optional 1Password auto-login mapping and custom login form selectors.

item.description: 1Password item title, ID, or op://<vault>/<item> reference.

vault.description: Preferred 1Password vault name or alias (e.g. "AI", "AI bots", "intelia", "lana").

usernameRef.description: Direct op:// reference for the username field.

passwordRef.description: Direct op:// reference for the password field.

otpRef.description: Direct op:// reference for the OTP/TOTP field.

usernameField.description: Field label or ID inside the 1Password item for the username.

passwordField.description: Field label or ID inside the 1Password item for the password.

otpField.description: Field label or ID inside the 1Password item for the TOTP code.

usernameSelector.description: Custom CSS selector for the login username/email input.

passwordSelector.description: Custom CSS selector for the login password input.

otpSelector.description: Custom CSS selector for the 2FA/OTP input.

nextSelector.description: Custom CSS selector for the 'Continue/Next' button in 2-step logins.

submitSelector.description: Custom CSS selector for the login submit button.

logoutUrl.description: Optional URL to navigate to for logging out of the current session before switching accounts.

logoutSteps.description: Optional declarative steps (click/wait) to log out via the page UI before clearing session data.

accountHintSelector.description: Optional CSS selector where the currently logged-in user email or account name is displayed.

extract.description: How to read invoice rows and fields from the page.

preSteps.description: Interactions performed before the invoice list is visible.

rows.description: CSS selector matching each invoice row/item.

fallbackRows.description: Alternate row selector used when rows matches nothing.

fields.description: Field extractors keyed by field name. Selectors are relative to the row.

downloadLinks.description: Selector for multiple download links within a row (fan-out).

dedup.description: Field name to deduplicate downloads by.

allowMissingUrl.description: Keep rows that have no download URL (URL is resolved at download time).

download.description: How to download each extracted invoice.

filenameTemplate.description: Output filename. Supports {{field}} placeholders from extracted fields.

steps.description: Click sequence for the click-download method.

dismissSelectors.description: Selectors for dialogs/overlays to dismiss during click-download.

postLoadClick.description: Button to click after the page loads (chrome-download).

urlTemplate.description: Template used to build the download URL (e.g. fetch-blob).

urlSuffix.description: String appended to the download URL (chrome-download).

dateFormat.description: How the extracted date string is parsed.

textMatch.description: Case-insensitive text filter. A string, or an array of alternatives.

title.description: Label shown in the config UI.

hintUrl.description: Link to where the value can be found.

multi.description: Allow multiple values; provider is expanded one entry per value.

pattern.description: Validation regex applied after extracting an identifier from a pasted URL.

validationMessage.description: Actionable error shown for invalid configured values.

capture.description: Explicitly capture a config identifier from the current page URL or matching links. Multiple distinct identifiers require user selection. Capture group 1 of urlPattern is the identifier; the same pattern accepts pasted URLs.

origin.description: Exact origin of the page allowed to supply identifiers.

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after the action.

timeout.description: Milliseconds to wait for the selector (waitFor).

downloadStep.description: A single click in a click-download sequence.

selector.description: CSS selector, or the literal "self" to click the row element.

scope.description: Where to search for the selector.

optional.description: Do not fail the download if this step matches nothing.

wait.description: Milliseconds to wait after the click.

pollTimeout.description: Milliseconds to poll for the element before giving up.

waitForDialogClose.description: Wait for a dialog to close after clicking.

fieldDef.description: Extractor for one field. All properties optional; omit selector to read the row itself.

selector.description: CSS selector relative to the row. Null/omitted reads the row element.

attr.description: Attribute or property to read (e.g. textContent, innerText, href, data-*).

regex.description: Regular expression applied to the extracted value.

regexGroup.description: Capture group index to keep from regex.

resolve.description: Resolve a relative URL to absolute using the page URL.

template.description: Build the value from a template with {{field}} placeholders.

type.description: select: engine clicks dropdown options (AJAX). url-page: full navigation. click-next: engine clicks an in-page next button (AJAX).

openSelector.description: select: selector to open the dropdown.

optionSelector.description: select: selector for each option to click through.

nextSelector.description: url-page / click-next: selector for the next-page link or button.

nextText.description: click-next: text filter for the next-page button (case-insensitive substring; array = any match, for multi-language UIs).

pick.description: click-next: which matching next-page button to click (default first).
